name: Skeleton (Isolde reference)

ac.type: armor scraps; original Monster Manual reference

languages: Understands languages known in life but cannot speak.
bio: Original Monster Manual Skeleton reference for an actually created Animate Dead servant. No undead are supplied at character creation. Track 24-hour control, actual equipment, individual HP and Dirge dice separately.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.description: Does not need air, food, drink or sleep.

traits.name: Dirge die (conditional)
traits.description: When actually granted by Stir the Bones, may hold a d8 Dirge die for 10 minutes. If used to turn an attack into a hit, also add its result to damage. Do not assume this die is always active.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Requires the servant actually to have this weapon.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Requires a shortbow and ammunition; Isolde purchased equipment for up to four archers.
